query: How can I file a complaint regarding online scams?
reference_answer:
Reporting Online Fraud:
To report online fraud, visit the nearest police station or:
- File a complaint on the Tamil Nadu Police website
- Call the Cyber Crime Helpline (1930)
- Provide transaction details and supporting documents
answer: To file a complaint about online scams, report them to the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) at ftc.gov/complaint or call 1-877-FTC-HELP. [Document 1]
